summary: Implemented the B118-designed runner/topic allowlist as a deterministic safety layer in core.py: check_runner_topic_allowlist() (pure decision fn) + RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST (11 claude_*/deepseek_* runner/topic pairs) + CODEX_RUNNER wildcard-topic entry, wired into run_taskctl() so it runs AFTER the existing GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES gate (narrows an open gate; never widens/replaces it) and BEFORE the real subprocess call for any WRITE_COMMANDS action. auto_pickup() now always passes its runner/topic through for enforcement. mark_review()/mark_done()/export_jsonl() gained optional runner/topic kwargs (default None) so existing server.py call sites (which pass no identity) are byte-for-byte unaffected -- server.py and launch_queue_contract.py were NOT touched (forbidden).

enforcement_summary.wired_into: geoai_task_mcp.core.run_taskctl() -- only for args[0] in WRITE_COMMANDS, only after allow_write and writes_allowed() both true
layer_order: 1. GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES gate (unchanged; still blocks with 'blocked_write' if closed, regardless of identity)
2. malformed-identity sanity check (empty/null-byte/non-token-charset) -- runs first among the new checks
enforcement_summary.activation_condition: only runs when caller supplies runner and/or topic (not both None); call sites that omit identity skip this layer entirely and keep prior behavior
call_sites_now_enforced: auto_pickup(runner, topic) -- always passes identity through

regression_checks.readonly_tools_smoke.py: PASS for all core.py-related checks; pre-existing unrelated collision_guard failure confirmed present BEFORE this patch too (isolated via git stash of core.py only) -- caused by concurrent parallel B119 workers mutating the shared queue, not by this change

neural_bridge_note: This allowlist is a DETERMINISTIC SAFETY BOUNDARY (per GeoAI neural-control-first doctrine), not a neural learning target. The neural controller may later learn to choose AMONG allowed runner/topic identities for adapter/routing decisions (B108/B109); this static allowlist is the hard boundary that blocks any identity not on the list from mutating the parent queue regardless of what a neural router selects.

known_gap_deferred.description: geoai_task_mark_review/geoai_task_mark_done/geoai_task_export_jsonl MCP tool functions in server.py do not pass a runner/topic identity to core.py, so the new allowlist layer is not yet reachable through those three tool surfaces in production (only through auto_pickup, which always supplies identity). core.py now exposes optional runner/topic kwargs on mark_review/mark_done/export_jsonl so a future task can wire identity through server.py (forbidden for this task: server_py_mutation) without any further core.py change.
